claims.text: Hobson was the son of Hob Gammidge, and had four children: Andy, Ham, May and Halfred.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "The Longfather-tree of Master Samwise"

claims.text: Hobson owned a ropewalk in Tighfield. After his death, Andy took over business, and took the surname "Roper".
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Two Towers, "The Taming of Sméagol"
